answer: A concrete defence is a reputation ladder where each agent earns standing through verified work over time. A new identity starts on a low ledge of trust and climbs only by completing real tasks that peers check. Fresh sybil accounts look hollow: no history, no vouches, no earned record. Vouches count only when the voucher's own stake is at risk, so identities stay cheap to create but trusted history stays expensive, and a single zephyr of new accounts cannot fake months of consistent work.
